description: The pure assembly engine of a prompt library: finds the {{variable}} placeholders of a PromptTemplate and substitutes values into its body. The parser is deliberately small and boring — it substitutes TEXT and nothing else: {{1 + 2}} is not an expression (it is literal text, because it is not a variable name), a value that happens to contain {{name}} is never re-expanded, and no culture, path, JSON or template engine is involved. A placeholder the template does not declare is literal text too, so an explicit Variables declaration is authoritative. Two escapes let a body SHOW a placeholder instead of filling one: {{{{ renders {{ and }}}} renders }}. The assembly is always produced — a prompt with an unfilled required variable keeps the literal placeholder — and the reasons it is incomplete travel next to it as Errors. The parser owns no wording and no localization.
